title: Recorded task session
description: A deliberate frame sequence connecting a Player scan, Task Node session, completion report, and controller recording confirmation.

entries.note: Player endpoint 3 reports a scanned tag observation.
The recorded exchange asks Task endpoint 7 to start session 1.
Task endpoint 7 reports the recorded session-start result.
Player endpoint 3 receives the recorded result for its scan.
An opportunistic progress milestone appears in the capture.
Task endpoint 7 reports its retained terminal outcome.
The recorded controller response confirms receipt of the outcome.
